request_text.description: The change as stated by the requester, unparaphrased.

repository.description: Repository or working-tree identifier the change lands in.

target_paths.description: Paths the requester believes are in scope. A belief, not a finding — the reading phase may contradict it.

acceptance_criteria.description: Observations that would show the change was made. Each entry must be checkable by someone who did not write the change.

change_set_branch.description: The change-set branch (changeset/<originating-gig-uuid>[/<slug>]) the implementation run must work on. CARRIED here, never inferred from the working tree. Optional and additive: a request that omits it is refused as branch-absent-but-expected only where a run needs it.

change_set_base.description: The commit the change-set is measured from (git diff <base> -- <path> at seal), as a FULL sha. CARRIED here, never inferred from the working tree: the drain clones one commit deep, and prepareWorkspace fetches this commit into the tree while the gig's credential is in hand, so a change-set of DELIVERED work can name the parent of the landing commit. A full sha is required in practice: an abbreviated sha cannot be fetched, and a tag or branch name fetched into a shallow clone lands only in FETCH_HEAD, so the seal refuses it base_not_in_tree. Optional and additive; absent, the seat's own base must already be in the tree or the seal refuses base_not_in_tree.

content_hash.description: The graded spec's content hash the red pass drafts against.

spec_grade.description: The id of the Chancery spec_grade record that passed the spec.

scope.description: What a red pass may write: {files: [path], laws: [law id], terms: [term id]}.

baseline_commit.description: The commit the red pass is measured from (the baseline the loop is run on).

branch.description: The branch the red pass writes.
